scenes.heading: Postgres snapshots in one command
scenes.sub: pgsnap saves your database with a single command and brings it back just as fast.

scenes.text: Database backups should be one command, not a runbook.

steps.output:
Snapshot saved: shop-db-2025-06-01.pgdump
412 MB in 9 seconds.

scenes.source:
pgsnap save                       # snapshot now
pgsnap list                       # see every snapshot
pgsnap restore shop-db-2025-06-01 # back in seconds
scenes.caption: The whole tool is three verbs.

steps.output:
Restoring shop-db-2025-06-01...
412 MB, 128 tables, 1.2M rows back in 14 seconds.

scenes.text: Reset your dev database between tests. Roll back after a bad migration.
